text: I. Professional OverviewOptoelectronic engineering is an interdisciplinary subject that integrates optics, electronics, computer science and engineering, focusing on the interaction between light and electricity and their applications in information transmission, energy conversion, detection and control, and other fields. Its core research areas include: the generation, transmission and processing of optical signals (such as optical fiber communication), the design of optoelectronic functional devices (such as laser diodes, image sensors), and the integration of optoelectronic systems (such as photolithography machines, infrared imaging equipment), etc. It is a key basic discipline that promotes the upgrading of industries such as information technology, new energy, and medical equipment.Ii. Training ObjectivesCultivate compound talents with solid theoretical foundations in optics and electronics and proficient abilities in the design and engineering practice of optoelectronic systems. Students are required to master core skills such as photoelectric detection technology, laser principles, optical communication principles, and the development of photoelectric instruments. They should be able to engage in scientific research, product development, engineering design, system integration, and technical management in fields such as optoelectronic technology, communication engineering, semiconductor manufacturing, and precision instruments, and serve the demands of the photoelectric industry under national strategies such as "new infrastructure" and "intelligent manufacturing".
